Workspace overwrite/deletion shadowing without duplicate ranks
MDB/oneTBB collision buckets, reserved-output allocation-free selection
No copying a 2 MiB opaque root or reading a 2 MiB paged String payload

Stale/error indexes, empty failure output and finite retries

limits: Full Redis service remains incomplete; cross-DB atomic MOVE, Streams, scripting, standard replication and wider administration pending
Configured shard/bucket selection and key copying remain; exclusive admission still serializes sampling with other KV work
Disk/workspace rank selection streams O(database keys); expired-only disk populations can require repeated scans
Selection holds exclusive admission and can delay other logical databases
Legacy selected-header decode retains its existing materialization costs
Read-only admission checks do not prove full Redis replica-expiry behavior
ASan uses the identified private ACL archive with fiber registration; no TSan
Internal pair coordination serializes KV work with exclusive admission
No disk cross-engine atomic writes or cross-DB atomic replay is claimed
Existing ordinary page effects were extracted into shared helpers
Process-kill recovery does not simulate hardware power failures
Unit engine error injection verifies the PKV boundary, not every real IO error
WAL barriers do not make subsequent writes durable or combine engines
Old pre-initialization-guard matrix was intentionally stopped and excluded
Three GET/write rounds do not establish significance or official Redis throughput
MDB adds a position and pointer per root, plus vector spare capacity; oneTBB replaces scan hash-set nodes with positions and pointer arrays

Resident RSS includes allocator/runtime/caches; it is not exact index memory
